# EngineeringXYZ

> Design-only industrial automation, machine-design, and control-system support
> in Laguna Beach, California for manufacturers and industrial R&D teams.

Last updated: 2026-08-18
Canonical site: https://engineeringxyz.com
Contact: info@engineeringxyz.com · 760-515-1517
Mailing address: EngineeringXYZ, 1968 S. Coast Hwy #334, Laguna Beach CA 92651.
Service area: Southern California on-site; remote clients nationwide.

EngineeringXYZ considers work for manufacturers, industrial R&D teams,
utilities, and other industrial companies when the work is
connected with their own products, systems, or services. Marco Wu, Ph.D. in
Mechanical Engineering, serves as project lead for each agreed EngineeringXYZ
scope. Each client, vendor, installer, and specialist remains responsible for
its own work as defined in the written project agreement.

EngineeringXYZ delivers engineering documentation only. Clients procure all
hardware, engage their own fabricators and UL 508A panel shops, and retain
licensed C-10 electrical contractors for field wiring and facility electrical
installation. Clients own, install, operate, and maintain the resulting
equipment. EngineeringXYZ is not a California-licensed professional engineering
firm and does not offer civil, structural, building/facility engineering or
PE-stamped services. Organizational eligibility and technical fit are reviewed
before an engagement begins.

## Services

- **Machine and Prototype Design Support** — concept layouts, machine
  architecture, 3D CAD, drawing documentation, design reviews, and support for
  client-led testing and commissioning.
- **Fixture and Workholding Design Support** — fixture concepts,
  mistake-proofing, operator-flow improvements, tolerance and interface
  review, and fabrication drawings.
- **Internal Inspection and Test-Equipment Design Support** — positioning
  systems, test-station design, part-presentation fixtures, and interfaces with gauges
  and optics.
- **CAD and Drawing Documentation for Industrial Equipment** — 3D CAD,
  drawings with GD&T as appropriate, tolerance review, design-for-assembly,
  and drawing-release support.
- **Manufacturing-Process and Internal-Equipment Design Support** — equipment
  layouts, architecture and simplification studies, and design packages for
  client and vendor review.
- **Defined Project-Recovery and Design-Capacity Support** — design review,
  troubleshooting, defined overflow design work, vendor coordination, and
  handoff packages.
- **Control System and Machine Electrical Design Support** — control
  architecture, I/O lists, machine electrical schematics prepared using NFPA 79
  as a design reference, component specification, PLC/HMI programming, and
  engineering support during client-led testing and commissioning. Panel
  building, field wiring, and facility connection remain with the client's own
  panel shop and licensed electrical contractor.

## Process

Share the current problem → review technical fit → define a focused first
scope. Most engagements start with a design review, concept package, or single
fixture. First scopes typically run two to four weeks. Confidential project
information can be reviewed under NDA.

## Claim boundaries

EngineeringXYZ publishes no staff-size, office-size, revenue, or certification
claims. It is presented as a design-only industrial automation, machine-design,
and control-system practice led by Marco Wu, Ph.D., with defined specialist
support when scope requires. It does not purchase or resell hardware, build or
warrant completed machines, perform installation work, or direct the means and
methods of licensed trades.
